Class InlineToolkitRunner

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.app.InlineToolkitRunner
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class InlineToolkitRunner extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Element-based inline runner - no manual rendering.

InlineToolkitRunner combines the element-based DSL of ToolkitRunner with the inline display semantics of InlineTuiRunner. It provides:

  • Element-based rendering (no manual widget composition)
  • Automatic event routing to elements
  • Focus management
  • CSS styling support
  • Tick events for animations (WaveText, etc.)
  • Inline display (no alternate screen)
import static dev.tamboui.toolkit.Toolkit.*;

try (var runner = InlineToolkitRunner.create(4)) {
    double[] progress = {0.0};

    runner.run(() -> column(
        waveText("Installing...").cyan(),
        gauge(progress[0]).label(String.format("%.0f%%", progress[0] * 100))
    ));
}

    • run

      public void run(Supplier<Element> elementSupplier) throws Exception
      Runs the application with the given element supplier.

      The supplier is called each frame to get the current UI state. Events are routed to elements based on their handlers.

      Parameters:
      elementSupplier - provides the root element for each render
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during execution

    • println

      public void println(Element element)
      Prints an element above the viewport.

    • schedule

      public ToolkitRunner.ScheduledAction schedule(Runnable action, Duration delay)
      Schedules an action to run after a delay.

      The action runs on the scheduler thread. If the action modifies UI state, use runOnRenderThread(Runnable) to ensure thread safety.

      Parameters:
      action - the action to run
      delay - the delay before running
      Returns:
      a handle that can be used to cancel the scheduled action
